thread:
maria: quick heads-up — replay harness v2 shows a tenant-specific tail spike after we enabled adaptive kernel selection on pool-3. putting raw numbers below, need eyes.
kevin: can you paste the p50/p95/p99 deltas? also which kernels toggled?
maria: p50 stable, p95 +18ms, p99 +72ms for tenant:B (high concurrency). we switched matmul->matmul_opt_v7 for seq_len>1024. reproduction: run replay-harness with tenant tagging and continuous-batching on.
kevin: hmm that smells like queueing interference. did KV cache hit rates change for tenant B?
maria: KV cache hit ratio unchanged (~91%), but we saw more microbursts that grew batch sizes beyond batch_cap. log snippet:
```
[2026-03-10T14:22:11Z] tenant=B req_id=... batch_size=42 max_delay_ms=20 kernel=matmul_opt_v7 latency=184ms
[2026-03-10T14:22:11Z] tenant=A req_id=... batch_size=38 kernel=matmul base latency=80ms
```
arjun: did the kernel switch change per-sample execution variance? matmul_opt_v7 might have higher variance when run with mixed batch shapes.
sara: I ran a small microbench — matmul_opt_v7 is ~10% faster median on long sequences but has heavier tail with heterogeneous batch dims (padding overhead).
kevin: ok we need apples-to-apples: same batch composition, same queueing, same KV warmup. can we replay recorded arrival traces into isolated pools vs mixed pools?
maria: yes. I ran three experiments: (1) replay into isolated pool (tenant-only), (2) mixed pool, (3) synthetic Poisson with same QPS. results: isolated p99=110ms, mixed p99=182ms, synthetic p99=120ms. so mixed pool is main factor.
perf-bot: perf-alert: kernel=matmul_opt_v7 shows higher 99.9th latency under mixed-tenancy profiles (threshold exceeded)
deploy-bot: rollout is currently at 30% on pool-3 (canary) per policy.
kevin: rollback candidate? or can we tune batching heuristics: lower max_delay_ms, enforce tenant-aware batch caps?
sara: suggest change: per-tenant batch_cap = min(global_cap, tenant_quota_cap), and add adaptive_max_delay_ms that decays on contention. quick config:
```
continuous_batching:
  global_batch_cap: 64
  per_tenant_cap_ratio: 0.6
  max_delay_ms: 12
  adaptive_max_delay_ms: true
```
arjun: also try pinning kernel variant per-tenant temporarily (tenant B -> matmul) while we tune heuristics.
maria: I'll schedule 3 runs on replay-harness v2: (A) pin kernel, (B) tenant-aware caps, (C) lower max_delay. will post results.
kevin: for the apples-to-apples comparison, make sure to control RNG seed for replay (timestamp offsets), and capture per-request KV cache state. use `replay-harness --snapshot-kv --seed 42`. also collect low-level perf counters (L2 miss, memcpy) — matmul_opt_v7 did more memcpy in my microbench.
maria: noted. also adding kprobe logs and kernel selection traces to the payload.
sara: if matmul_opt_v7 memcopy is the issue, we can try a modified tiling kernel or fused memcpy path; but that's more dev work.
kevin: temporary mitigation: reduce global_batch_cap to 48 and set per-tenant ratio to 0.5 for pool-3, push to canary.
maria: starting run A now (pin kernel). will report numbers in ~20m. thx.
arjun: also file incident ticket so SRE knows it's being tracked.
kevin: thanks, team. let's avoid a blind rollback unless numbers push customer SLOs. :thumbsup:
_notes: thread contains kernel selection, batching heuristics, kv cache checks, replay methodology and mitigation plans
